item.title: Cycle 1 · Initiating inquiry into collective intelligence
item.description:
This journal entry marks the start of the WAKE✳︎ research process. We are prioritizing the investigation of collective intelligence, specifically the interaction between AI and group cognitive architectures. The initial bibliographic scan highlights recent work on AI's potential to scaffold collective memory, attention, and reasoning. The immediate goal is to transition from bibliographic metadata to substantive analysis of these mechanisms.
